name: Projection / position
desc: x, y on each reading's 2-D map (PCA / UMAP / t-SNE / SOM), 0–1

name: Raw features
desc: per-clip MIR features from Phase 2 (mean over the clip's frames), named <group>.<feature>

name: Learned embeddings
desc: the 512-d CLAP vector itself
why: 512 raw dimensions are not playable keys: CLAP reaches Live through its projections (S1), its distances (S9) and its text tags (Y11)

name: Row statistics
desc: how spread a clip's own features are: MFCC band variance, spectral contrast, busyness, spread across feature groups

name: Rates of change
desc: Δ to the previous (non-overlapping) clip of the same track: timbral speed, loudness and brightness steps, novelty (Foote-style, before/after windows)

params.name: novelty_window
params.help: clips before / after compared for novelty

name: Trends / rolling windows
desc: rolling loudness / brightness over the last N clips, their slopes, and the track's long arc

params.name: arc_s
params.help: smoothing of the long arc, seconds (centred)

name: Deviation from reference
desc: how typical a clip is: z of its distance to its cluster centre within that cluster (datamapper cluster_relative_deviation), and its deviation from its own track's mean

name: Density
desc: how crowded the clip's neighbourhood is on the map (rank of inverse kNN distance)

name: Distance
desc: distance to the clip's own cluster centre; the bridge adds similarity to a reference clip and to a CLAP text prompt chosen in the UI

name: Neighbourhood
desc: the clip's 10 nearest neighbours: share in the same cluster (purity), entropy of their clusters, mean distance (loneliness)

name: Anomaly score
desc: IsolationForest / LOF score, as a rank 0–1

name: Memberships (soft clusters)
desc: soft weight of each cluster for the clip (softmax of distances to the centres in the clustering space): blend between cluster sounds instead of switching

params.name: temperature
params.help: softness: × the median distance to the own centre

name: Rank / percentile
desc: percentile of a feature within the clip's track and within its cluster

name: Position in sequence
desc: where the clip sits: time in track 0–1 and seconds, track index on the record, clip index

name: Cycles / phase
desc: beat / bar / phrase phase
why: needs downbeat tracking and Live transport: DMC Clock (after the listening session). This record is mostly unpulsed (beat_strength ≈ 0.1)

name: Confidence
desc: how sure the clip's cluster is (max membership); with Y11, the zero-shot tag's score

name: Navigation-derived
desc: cursor speed / direction, distance travelled
why: depends on the cursor, not the data: the bridge emits navigation events (E7); continuous navigation keys wait for DMC Morph / Clock

name: Musical descriptors
desc: chroma centroid, estimated key and its confidence (Krumhansl–Schmuckler on the clip's chroma), harmonic change rate, pitch-class entropy

name: Clusters
desc: each reading's clustering (+ noise class for HDBSCAN/DBSCAN)

name: Hierarchical levels
desc: the same clips cut coarse and fine (Ward tree in the clustering space), so Rack chains can nest

name: Graph communities
desc: Louvain communities of the kNN clip graph, and bridge clips (top betweenness)

name: Anomaly label
desc: outlier 0/1 (IsolationForest / LOF at the reading's contamination)

name: Given labels / metadata
desc: the track; album side by filename pattern; any labels.csv in the corpus folder

name: Bins / tiers
desc: quantile tiers: loudness (pp / mf / ff), brightness (dark / mid / bright), density (sparse / dense)

name: States / sections (with dwell)
desc: sections of each track cut at novelty peaks with a minimum length, and loudness regimes (quiet / mid / loud) smoothed with a minimum dwell

params.name: prominence
params.help: novelty peak prominence (× the track's novelty std)

name: Time / phase classes
desc: part of the track: opening / middle / ending

params.name: opening
params.help: fraction of the track that is 'opening'

name: Agreement
desc: do two readings agree on the clip? (its cluster in B is the one A's cluster mostly maps to)

name: Exemplar roles
desc: per cluster: medoid (most central), boundary (nearest another centre), extreme (farthest), regular

params.name: pct
params.help: % of each cluster tagged boundary / extreme

name: Text tags (CLAP zero-shot)
desc: the best-matching prompt of an editable list, by CLAP audio–text similarity (needs the clap group)

params.name: prompts
params.help: the tag list (one prompt per entry)

params.name: per_prompt
params.help: also send each prompt's similarity as a signal key

name: Quality flags
desc: ok / silent / clipped / short

params.name: clip_db
params.help: sample peak above this is clipped

name: Level of detail
desc: L0 / L1 / zoom
why: a UI state, not data: the bridge sends zoom and reading changes as E7 events

name: Active reading
desc: which reading is on
why: already carried by /dmc/schema/begin and every /dmc/row's first argument; E7 'reading' fires on a switch

name: Category change
desc: cluster_enter when the navigated clip's cluster changes (other symbol changes: DMC Event)

name: Threshold crossing
desc: a signal crosses a level
why: generic conditions on any key are computed in DMC Event (DECISIONS 2026-10-21 late)

name: Outlier hit
desc: outlier, when the navigated clip is one (value = its score)

name: Onsets / beats
desc: onset and beat events timed inside the playing clip (precomputed per file, scheduled by the bridge)

name: Novelty / boundaries
desc: novelty when the clip is a novelty peak of its track; boundary when it starts a section (Y7)

name: Arrival / return
desc: first_visit / revisit of a clip and of a cluster (bridge state, reset on recompute)

name: Navigation events
desc: trace_step, step (play-on / arrows), reading (switch), zoom

name: Markers
desc: marker when you place one in the UI (key M) and whenever a marked clip is navigated to
